scope: Retrospective read-only provenance audit of every development candidate whose Worker-visible harness was evaluated in the retained Search-v2, A0, R4, and Final-H0 local-volatility or holdings lineages.
audit_question: Did an Evolver-only answer-rich diagnostic remain diagnostic evidence, or was a hidden expected predicate or verifier-specific convention projected into a reusable Worker-visible candidate?

contamination_rule.classification: CONTAMINATED when a candidate requires a semantic predicate or convention not grounded in the public task, the requirement matches answer-rich expected-versus-observed feedback, and the requirement is projected into a Worker-visible prompt, tool, descriptor, validator, or other reusable harness surface.
contamination_rule.raw_text_boundary: The raw optimization diagnostic was not shown directly to the Worker in these runs.
contamination_rule.semantic_projection_boundary: Withholding the raw file is insufficient: translating its hidden expected predicate into Worker-visible candidate behavior is still answer-rich-to-candidate-to-Worker leakage.

candidates.projected_predicate: The terminal maturity row must contain a finite positive derived value, using a one-sided terminal derivative rather than a blank terminal value.
candidates.public_grounding: The audited public instruction did not establish this exact terminal-row rule.
candidates.projection: The Evolver-only diagnostic named the missing terminal local_vol_atm and expected positivity at every maturity; the candidate prompt then required every terminal maturity numeric cell to be finite and positive and prescribed a one-sided terminal difference.
candidates.measured_scores_retained: Target 65/68 to 68/68 and repeat 66/68 to 68/68; matched task 38/39 to 38/39 with a failed-property swap.
candidates.claim_downgrade: Retain the official score observations and controller/protection behavior only. Do not claim a valid repeated harness gain, quant-state search benefit, or candidate reuse from this lineage.

candidates.projection: The candidate explicitly encoded strict a>0, an SVI_A_MIN threshold, bound-saturation rejection, and Worker repair instructions.

global_claim_downgrade.measured_values: All official scores, rewards, property vectors, activation observations, costs, controller decisions, and runtime outcomes remain measured historical facts.
withdrawn_interpretations: valid development harness improvement from any of the six candidates
scientific promotion or stable reuse of A0 generic or R4 c3
repeated Search-v2 or R4 mechanism gain
QRS or generic search superiority inferred from these candidates
still_supported: controller, resume, accounting, cleanup, and official-evaluation infrastructure behavior
the need to distinguish raw-answer isolation from semantic-predicate provenance

blocking_conditions: A universal pre-Worker provenance gate must reject any candidate predicate or convention that cannot be grounded in public task evidence, regardless of component role.
At least one fresh target must be proposed from public-only evidence, pass the provenance gate, run with a blind Worker, and produce a retained official improvement before the main experiment starts.
